title: 第23章 伴生帝兵几百门亲事第24章 登临天女圣地初代圣主遗留
slug: 被问罪当天无上帝族杀来
content_zh:
陈霸道点头道：“好，我会派一个叫陈奴的帮手给你。”
“他的实力，就是上界来人，也没几个是他的对手。”
“至于后面要怎么安排他，你可自行决定。”
陈稳连忙点头，“那敢情好。”
将一切安排妥当后，陈霸道才道“你进来吧。”
在门外候着的姜太初，连忙打开门进来。
“小人，见过五位大人。”姜太初再次叩首道。
陈霸道看了姜太初一眼，“接下来由你带我儿去天女圣地，你只需听他的命令便可。”
“此事做好了，本座可以既往不咎，还会记你一功。”
“若他有不测，那与你相关的所有人都得死。”
姜太初又惊又惧，“小人定不负所托，还请大人放心。”
“去准备吧。”陈霸道摆了摆手。
“是，大人。”姜太初郑重地叩了一个首，然后快速离开了。
“对了，你的那个未婚妻叫楼兰胜雪，如果你确认她与那小子有染了，就直接休了便可。”
“当然了，她若助纣为虐，那就直接杀了。”
说到这，陈霸道霸气无匹，“我陈族之子弟，不用将就，更不怕任何势力。”
老爹，威武霸气。
听到这，陈稳是真想为陈霸道鼓个大拇指。
不过说又说回来。
如果那个楼兰胜雪，真的与楚天龙有染，那这事根本就没有回旋的余地。

不用陈霸道说，他也绝不容她存在。
叶沉雁这时也开口了，“儿啊，你爹说得对，这事是底线，任何人都僭越。”
“管她是什么隐世古国的公主，触及了也都得死。”
“到时候在你成年礼上，娘再为你张罗几百个亲家，随你去挑，直到满意为止。”
“就算你全要了，娘也可以为你做主。”
几百个亲家？
全要了，也能做主？
你可真是我亲娘啊。
陈稳深吸一口气，然后才道，“爹，娘，儿子知道怎么做了，一定会将此事处理妥当的。”
“明白就好，就好。”叶沉雁拍着陈稳的手背连连道。
“对了，这里有你的伴生帝剑，一直由爹替你管着，现在该还给你了。”
说着，陈霸道便将一个空间戒递给陈稳。
伴生帝兵？
我还有这种牛逼的东西？
作为玄幻小说迷，陈稳自然知道帝兵代表着什么。
而伴生帝兵，更是绝世妖孽出世才会拥有的，而且极其罕见。
content_en:
Chen Badao nodded and said, "Okay, I will send an assistant named Chen Nu to you."
"His strength is such that even if he comes from the upper realm, there are not many who can match him."
"As for how to arrange him later, you can decide by yourself."
Chen Wen nodded quickly, "That's good."
After everything was arranged, Chen Badao said, "Come in."
Jiang Taichu, who was waiting outside the door, quickly opened the door and came in.
"Young man, I have met five adults." Jiang Taichu kowtowed again.
Chen Badao glanced at Jiang Taichu and said, "Next, you will take my son to the Holy Land of the Goddess. You only need to obey his orders."
"Once this is done, I can put the blame in the past and you will be remembered."
"If something happens to him, everyone related to you will die."
Jiang Taichu was frightened and frightened, "I will definitely live up to my trust, sir. Please rest assured."
"Go get ready." Chen Badao waved his hand.
"Yes, sir." Jiang Taichu kowtowed solemnly, and then left quickly.
"By the way, your fiancée's name is Lou Lan Shengxue. If you confirm that she is having an affair with that kid, just divorce her."
"Of course, if she helps the emperor do evil, then she will be killed directly."
Speaking of this, Chen Badao was extremely domineering, "I, a descendant of the Chen clan, don't have to give in, let alone be afraid of any force."
Dad, you are mighty and domineering.
Hearing this, Chen Wen really wanted to give Chen Ba Dao a thumbs up.
But then again.
If that Loulan Shengxue really had an affair with Chu Tianlong, then there would be no room for maneuver on the matter.
Needless to say, Chen Badao would never allow her to exist.
Ye Chenyan also spoke at this time, "Son, your father is right, this matter is the bottom line, no one can overstep it."
"No matter what kind of princess she is from a hidden ancient country, she will die if she touches her."
"At your coming-of-age ceremony, Mom will arrange hundreds of in-laws for you, and you can choose as you like until you are satisfied."
"Even if you want it all, Mom can still make the decision for you."
Hundreds of in-laws?
If you want it all, can you still make the decision?
You are really my mother-in-law.
Chen Wen took a deep breath and then said, "Father, mother, my son knows what to do and will definitely handle this matter properly."
"As long as you understand, that's good." Ye Chenyan patted the back of Chen Wen's hand and said repeatedly.
"By the way, here is your accompanying Emperor Sword. Dad has been taking care of it for you. Now it's time to return it to you."
With that said, Chen Badao handed a space ring to Chen Wen.
Accompanying imperial soldiers?
Do I still have something awesome like this?
As a fan of fantasy novels, Chen Wen naturally knew what the imperial soldiers represented.
As for the accompanying imperial weapons, they are only possessed by the birth of a peerless monster, and they are extremely rare.
